reset: coordinated hard reset; not soft capture reset or fault clear
interface: in_valid pulse, opaque snapshot; immutable out_valid/out_ready snapshot with occurrences and saturated flag
policy: Two slots: immutable presented head plus a pending aggregate. While blocked preserve first pending snapshot and saturating count. Pending promotion precedes a simultaneous new input, which starts a new aggregate. With no pending input can replace a consumed head. All asserted input events contribute to count unless saturated, which explicitly marks a lower bound; individual details after first within aggregate are not retained.
integration_status: standalone module; not connected to core or PS; priority arbitration, EVENT encoding and transport remain pending
